name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-06-24.206.1) "*That the ruling of the President be dissented from*", which was introduced by Queensland Senator [Larissa Waters](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/larissa_waters) (Greens). This means it failed. ### What does this motion mean? Senator Waters is [opposing a ruling](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-06-24.201.1) by the President that "putting the question immediately means putting it immediately without debate."
